distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Cnestus ater from Fujian. Smith et al. (2022) records Fujian and Yunnan and adds locality evidence from Wenshan, Yunnan. The reviewed distribution is the union Fujian and Yunnan.

host_note: No confirmed host is promoted from either integrated Smith et al. source record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus ater (Eggers, 1923).
